Full-body vertical portrait, entire figure and all equipment inside frame with generous margins, dark neutral hangar background, no text, logos, unit markings, or watermark. The model-kit sheet controls only GN-X mechanical geometry, X-frame armor, GN Tau Drive, rifle and shield.
